Match conditions become the author's Pydantic type (Jack Heart: "i do think conditions should be pydantic"). Seating takes author models (e.g. Deal(deal=7)); stored and hashed as their JSON so keys and stored data are unchanged for equal values and old dict conditions stay readable; play receives them validated into its type (e.g. play(match: Match[Deal])), as etude.call validates a config into the parameter type. play keeps Match as its one argument. scratch/questions.md "Typed match conditions".
